page.layout: One printed page with two columns. Running head above the left column ("ת מ") and above the right column ("ת נ"). Page number "442" at the top left. Left column: entries down to the foot. Right column: entries, then a bare letter heading "ת נ", then further entries.

main_text.p: תִּמָּצֵא invenieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָצָא.
תִּמְצוּ exprimatis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. מָצַץ.
תִּמַּק tabefies, vel fiet, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָקַק.
תִּמַּקֶנָה tabefient, Zach. 14. 12. pro תִּמַּקְנָה, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. Rad. מָקַק.
תַּמֵּר exacerbes, Exod. 23. 21. pro תַּמֵּר, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. מָרַר ama-rum esse.
וַתַּמֵּר & rebellâsti, vel vit, (apoc. pro תַּמְּרָה,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. Rad. מָרָה.
תָּמָר, תְּמָרָה palma, תְּמֹרוֹת palmae, תָּמְרוֹ ejus, E-zech. 40. 22. (pro יו,) No. f. m. & No. f. f. & pl. f. ut & pl. m. aff. Rad. תָּמָר palma.
תִּמְרוּ rebellaveritis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. מָרָה.
תַּמְרִיקִין, תַּמְרוּק mundatio, mundationes earum, No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. מָרַק terfit.
תַּמְרוֹת elationes, constr. No. pl. f. תַּמְרוֹת; Rad. תָּמָר palma.
תַּמְרִים palmae, pl. m. No. תָּמָר; Rad. תָּמָר.
תַּמְשֵׁךְ protraheris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. מָשַׁךְ.
תַּמְתִּיק dulce fueris, vel fuit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָתַק.
תָּמַת integritas, תָּמְתּוֹ ejus, תָּמָתִי mea, f. f. constr. aff. No. תָּמָה, à f. m. תֹם, R. תָּמַם absolvi.
תֵּן, vel תֵּן da, pro תַּן; Imper. Kal, f. m. תְּנָה Pf. 8. 2. Inf. Kal, pro תִּתֵּן dare, seu ponere, pro ponis, Rad. נָתַן.
תְּנָאֲפֵנָה adulterantur, fut. Piel, 3. pl. f. Rad. נָאַף. תְּנָאִין

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation is small and partly blurred; vowel points on some words (e.g. תִּמָּצֵא, תְּנָאִין, the Kal forms) are read as far as the scan allows and may contain errors. The Latin abbreviations and numbers are copied as printed. The bare letter heading "ת נ" is set in the middle of the right column and is copied as a paragraph. The left-column "E-zech." and right-column "Im-per." are hyphenated line-end breaks. No text was lost, but the Hebrew forms of the "pro" references could not be verified letter by letter.
